Name: Odd Seadog's Furry Sprites
Author: OddSeadog
Description:
A sprite overhaul to make all the stardew valley characters into furries. Massively Work in Progress and nowhere near finished.

Currently only have Abigail done asset wise, need to figure out more about how the API functions but I'm leaving this here so I can update this and add more in the future

Downloads.Description:
•Replacement character sprites and portraits for NPCs to make them furries. (Currently Abigail and Alex are complete, the rest are in development)
•Sprite replacements also include the beach variant for bachelors and bachelorettes.
